# Avinash Saravanan (asarav) — full site reference

> Personal portfolio of Avinash Saravanan — computer scientist, engineer, and writer. A continuously updated documentation of my progress as an individual.

This file is the long-form companion to `/llms.txt`. It summarises the public pages and lists their primary content so an assistant can answer questions without crawling every page.

- Canonical URL: https://asarav.github.io
- Author: Avinash Saravanan
- Language: English
- Stack: Jekyll, SCSS, vanilla JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, GitHub Pages
- Content policy: no advertising, no tracking pixels, no third-party analytics

## Home

The home page opens with a large typographic portrait of the author's name and a chronological index of roles: novelist (2023), scientist/researcher (2021), amateur quantitative trader (2020), software engineer (2016), novice dancer (2016), globalization enthusiast (2013), hobby electric guitarist (2012), and film connoisseur (2010). It links to every section through a directory of image tiles. A small weather readout appears only when the visitor's browser can provide local weather.

## About

### Education

- **University of Michigan, Ann Arbor** — Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, minor in Asian Languages and Cultures with a focus on Japanese. Coursework and activities included the Lloyd Hall Scholars program, the Ross School of Business, and Circle K.
- **TU Delft** — MSc in Computer Science, Data Science and Technology track. Thesis work on conversational agents situated in a diet-based context for patients with type II diabetes, using shared experiences to support goal achievement.

### Professional experience

The About page documents roles at Perficient, 日本ソフト開発 (Nihon Soft Kaihatsu), Sony, Thomson Reuters, TU Delft, Helio/Be There, Repairify, and Coupa, in chronological order, with descriptions of the work and selected photographs.

### Research and publications

The site lists scientific publications and research work, including the master's thesis and course research in information retrieval, conversational agents, social signal processing, and related areas. Project write-ups provide the public record.

### Technical stack

Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Angular, Django, Flask, Pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, PyTorch, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub, Jekyll, Unity, LangChain, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. The page also lists languages, frameworks, databases, source-control tools, and other tools in more detail.

### Languages and interests

The About page describes Japanese language study (JLPT N2), some Dutch, and interests including electric guitar, foreign cultures, existential philosophy, dance, globalization, film, private equity trading, the commercial space industry, and AI.

## Status log

A chronological list of short public updates. Each entry has a date and a note. The log is the most frequently updated section.

## Contact

The contact page links to public profiles for code, writing, research, and professional networks. The email address is entity-encoded and not published as plain text. There is no availability or hiring pitch on the site.

## Machine-readable notes

- `robots.txt` disallows `/consumption/` for all crawlers, including AI crawlers.
- `/sitemap.xml` and `/feed.xml` are generated by Jekyll.
- Structured data on every page describes the author as a `Person` and the site as a `ProfilePage`.
- Page content is static HTML. JavaScript enhances motion, media, and weather but is not required to read the content.
